title: Chat Plugin
description: This project adds Discord-like chat features to Minecraft servers, including threaded message replies, emoji reactions, and interactive hover components that make conversations more organized and engaging.
body: ChatPlus is a Minecraft server plugin that enhances the basic chat system by adding Discord-like interactive features including threaded message replies, emoji reactions, and organized conversation management. The plugin assigns unique IDs to chat messages, allows players to reply to specific messages using /reply <messageID> <message>, react with emojis using /react <messageID> <emoji>, and displays conversations in threaded format with configurable depth limits and indentation for better readability on busy servers.
